title: Article VIII. On Contemplation and its Species according to the Devout Doctor [Bonaventure]

blocks.s: Among the most elevated contemplatives of divine things and the most experienced tasters of divine sweetness, the lord Bonaventure — the sweetest and most devout doctor — holds no small place, and seems to have written of contemplation more abundantly than most. From his overflowing works only a very few things are here selected, since his writings are, as is fitting, everywhere circulated and can easily be obtained.
